About this product

The Ubiquiti UACC-DAC-SFP10-3M is a 3-metre passive Direct Attach Cable (DAC) designed for reliable, high-speed network connections. This SFP+ to SFP+ twinax cable supports data transfer rates up to 10Gbps, making it an excellent solution for linking UniFi switches or other compatible devices over short distances. It provides a cost-effective and low-latency alternative to fibre optic modules for interconnecting equipment within a server rack or adjacent racks. This cable is fully compatible with Ubiquiti UniFi SFP+ ports and other devices that adhere to SFP+ standards.
